name: Miracle Herbal Hair Oil 150ml | Hair Growth, Strengthening & Shine Formula
description:
Miracle Hair Oil is a potent herbal formula that nourishes hair from root to tip. Enriched with natural oils and herbal extracts, it revitalizes weak roots, reduces hair fall, and promotes natural regrowth. This nutrient-rich blend strengthens strands, restores softness, shine, and resilience, and combats dandruff and scalp dryness. Suitable for daily use on all hair types, it leaves hair smooth, silky, and healthy.
Key Features
 Strengthens hair roots and prevents breakage
 Promotes natural and healthy hair growth
 Nourishes scalp and reduces dryness and itching
 Restores softness, shine, and manageability
 100% herbal formula, free from harsh chemicals
 150ml pack for regular use
How to Use
 Apply a few drops to scalp and hair
 Massage gently for 3–5 minutes
 Leave for at least 30 minutes or overnight
 Wash with mild shampoo
Material
Natural oils and herbal extracts
Safety Information
 For external use only
 Avoid contact with eyes
 Keep out of reach of children
 Discontinue if irritation occurs
Package Includes
 1 × 150ml Miracle Hair Oil
